purpose: Human review rounds of the 32-cell report-surface matrix. The last round is the current state of the strict local gate (npm run test:report-surfaces); an earlier pass never carries forward over a later fail or pending round.

rounds.scope: the complete 32-cell matrix: 24 screens, 4 A4 PDFs and their 34 page rasters
acceptedFollowUps: LOW: consider running page numbers or a repeated report ID for long printed reports; accepted as non-blocking for 0.2.2.
rounds.note: PASS combines historical pixel-identical transfers with a new Founder review. The complete matrix was first reviewed on 2026-08-26. A 2026-08-28 transfer covered a later render only while all 24 screen PNGs and all 34 page rasters remained byte-identical. The page-number repair then changed exactly 18 screen PNGs and one page raster in each of findings, infrastructure and insufficient-coverage (21 visibly changed views total), so that transfer was not reused for those cells. The Founder reviewed an explicit old/difference/new gallery for all 21 changed views plus the complete four-PDF set and gave the exact PASS on 2026-08-29. Those changed cells and current PDF bytes carry the new reviewedAt. Cells whose current PNG or page-raster bytes remain identical retain their original review timestamp and are labelled as transfers, not new reviews. The stable reviewArtifactFingerprint for every cell is rebound to the current source/input fingerprint and exact review environment; any later source, environment or visible-pixel drift returns the gate to red.

rounds.scope: the rendered screens across four report states, two themes and three viewports, and all four A4 PDFs
headlineFindings: three of the four PDFs contain pages filled to 29–45 %
the printed clean state loses its findings section and its footer
printed pages 2 onwards carry no page number or running head
the display and body font stacks collapse to the same family on a Linux CI container
the mobile screens are rendered as single 390 x 15 000 px strips that cannot be judged
rounds.note: Written after the fact, when ledger schema 5 made a failed round recordable. Schema 4 could hold only an all-pass record, so this outcome existed as prose in docs/releasing.md and docs/status.md alone. Only what that public record states is entered here: the date, the outcome, the finding counts by severity, the scope and the headline findings. Per-cell outcomes, reviewer handles, the rendered input fingerprint and the render environment were not recorded at the time and are not reconstructed.

0.7.0 release review on macOS, rendered on the reviewer's machine at the merge commit of PR #18. All 32 cells passed. The three known residuals are accepted: the tail label prints on every finding, an over-long evidence name wraps inside itself, ubuntu-latest font resolution is unmeasured (NEEDS-CI). reviewedAt is the time the reviewer confirmed the outcome.
